headline: H100 SXM index falls -25% over 7 days to $4.32 while B200, MI300X and A100 hold flat.
bullets: H100 SXM led the week's moves, with its market index down -25% to $4.32 across 12 providers, and RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $2.69.
H200 eased -6% to a $5.40 index, with neocloud at $5.29 versus hyperscaler at $10.30, a +95% premium.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, edging B200 at $3.78, though only 4 providers list it.
Hyperscaler premiums are widest on H100 SXM at +162% ($10.68 vs $4.07 neocloud) and narrowest on B200 at +77% ($14.12 vs $7.99).
A100 80GB SXM is flat at a $2.70 index but is the weakest value at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.11.
watch: Whether the H100 SXM decline narrows its gap to the $5.40 H200 index and pulls H200 pricing down further from its -6% weekly move.
